name: zhihu_search
description: Search Zhihu through the Zhihu OpenAPI and return normalized markdown results with structured sources and items.
promptDescription: Search Zhihu through the Zhihu OpenAPI. Required [query] is the search text. Optional [searchType] selects zhihu_search or global_search; aliases zhihu, site, global, and all are accepted. Optional [count] controls result count and is capped by the selected search type: zhihu_search returns 1-10 results, global_search returns 1-20 results. Optional [timeoutMs] controls request timeout. Optional [maxOutputChars] controls markdown output length. Optional [description] records why the lookup is being run. API secrets should be configured in tool user config or ZHIHU_ACCESS_SECRET, not placed in prompts. The tool returns markdown plus metadata including searchType, query, resultsCount, statusCode, durationMs, code, apiMessage, sources, and items.
